name: 64138 · Raytown, MO
findings: ZIP 64138 (Raytown) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64138 (Raytown) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 64138 (Raytown) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
